verdict.description: accept only when every ACCEPT condition in validate-gap-prompt.md holds. Uncertain is reject.

target_skill.description: Skill the gap is attributed to, after re-attribution. Echo the input when the attribution is right.

gap.description: One-line repeatable rule deficit, normalized. Echo the input when it is already well formed.

duplicate_of.description: id of the signal in ===KNOWN_SIGNALS=== that this candidate restates, even when the wording differs. null only when the gap is genuinely new. Always null when verdict is accept.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim user sentence from the excerpt that proves the gap. Empty string when verdict is reject.

expected.description: What the skill should have done. Empty string when verdict is reject.

actual.description: What the skill did instead. Empty string when verdict is reject.

risk_class.description: valid_gap only when verdict is accept; otherwise the best-fitting reject class.

reason.description: One sentence naming the deciding evidence.
